companyPostings.title: My posts
companyPostings.subtitle: Browse your company’s jobs and projects. Create new ones or switch layout to focus the list you need.
companyPostings.payloadBody: The current listing API returns each row’s type, id, title, and domain. Additional fields (description, compensation, skills, etc.) can appear here automatically when the backend includes them—no UI change required.
companyPostings.schemaHeading: What a full job or project can include (database)
companyPostings.schemaJob: Jobs can store: title, description, job type, required experience, required skills, work mode, salary, preferred domain, embeddings, created/updated times.
companyPostings.schemaProject: Projects can store: title, description, project type, payment type, work mode, required experience, required skills, team size, duration, domain, budget/salary, embeddings, created/updated times.
